posts.text:
Reagan's Amnesty: Was It Really a Success?
An immigration attorney argued that Ronald Reagan granted amnesty to millions of illegal immigrants.
My question is simple: Are we better off today because of that decision or worse?
The immigration challenges America faces today are dramatically different from those of the 1980s. Looking back, it's fair to ask whether large-scale amnesty without lasting enforcement reforms produced the long-term results supporters hoped for.
